title: Rot und Schwarz
lyrics:
Rot und Schwarz, bis wir sterben!
Rotstadt, Rotstadt, unsere Stadt!
Wir sind hier, wir bleiben hier,
Rot und Schwarz für immer!

title: Brigade Marching Song
lyrics:
From the docks to the Rotstadion gates,
We march as one, we carry the weight,
Ninety minutes, we never sit down,
Brigade '58, the pride of this town.

title: Vento do Norte
lyrics:
Vento do norte, sopra mais forte,
Curva Vento Nord até a morte!
Azul e branco no meu coração,
Portovento é a nossa nação.

title: Anchor Song
lyrics:
We drop the anchor, we hold the line,
Through every storm, through every tide,
Blue and white, our flag unfurled,
Curva Vento against the world.

title: Løver Aldrig Alene
lyrics:
Grønne løver, aldrig alene,
Fra havnen følger vi jer allene,
Hjemme og ude, regn eller sol,
Nordhavn i vores hjerters idol.

title: Small But Loud
lyrics:
We might be small but we are loud,
A harbor town, a traveling crowd,
Every ground, near or far,
We follow the green and white star.

title: Piedra y Oro
lyrics:
Piedra y oro, sangre de esta tierra,
Frente Cantera, nunca en guerra sola,
Desde la cantera hasta el estadio,
Real Cantera, nuestro orgullo diario.

title: Quarry Song
lyrics:
Stone by stone, we built this pride,
Maroon and gold, side by side,
Cantera, hear us roar,
The old stone quarry, forevermore.

title: Zvijezda Gori
lyrics:
Zvijezda gori, plamen u noći,
Fanatici stižu, niko nas ne zaustavlja,
Crno i zlatno, do poslednjeg daha,
Zvijezda, Zvijezda, naša je snaga.

title: The Star Burns
lyrics:
The star burns bright in the dead of night,
Fanatici marching, ready to fight,
Black and gold until we're gone,
Zvijezda's fire carries on.
